def move(tcp,grip=-1,speed=.35,name='move',settle=30):
 o=r.get_obs(cameras=[])
 p=np.array(o.meta['proprio']['now'])
 goal=np.array(tcp)+(p[4:7]-p[:3])
 delta=goal-p[4:7]
 n=max(1,int(np.ceil(np.max(np.abs(delta))/(.01*speed))))
 A=np.zeros((n+settle,4));A[:n,:3]=delta/(.01*n);A[:,3]=grip
 o=save(r.submit('ee_delta',A,dt=r.spec()['control_dt'],cameras=cams,include_depth=True),name)
 print(name,np.array(o.meta['proprio']['now'])[:7].round(5).tolist())
 return o

def hold(grip,n=40,name='hold'):
 A=np.zeros((n,4));A[:,3]=grip
 o=save(r.submit('ee_delta',A,dt=r.spec()['control_dt'],cameras=cams,include_depth=True),name)
 print(name,np.array(o.meta['proprio']['now'])[:7].round(5).tolist())
 return o
